name: c0211-selinux-not-applicable
reason: Only seLinuxOptions fails C-0211. Nodes run Ubuntu with AppArmor, not SELinux; appArmorProfile RuntimeDefault is set explicitly. Other C-0211 fields are enforced at admission by Pod Security 'restricted'.

name: c0236-signatures-verified-by-kyverno
reason: Image signatures ARE verified, by the Kyverno ClusterPolicy verify-secureshop-signatures at admission (keyless Cosign, ci.yml@refs/heads/main), not by the annotation C-0236 inspects statically. Proven Day 12: an unsigned image from our own registry is denied at admission. Exception covers detection-method mismatch only, not the control's intent.
